basic_info.description: Situated in the highly desirable Richmond District, this elegant 1924 Fixer home showcases timeless period details, including built-in cabinetry, a warm fireplace, and a formal dining room perfect for entertaining.    Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout the home, adding warmth and timeless character to the space.    The main level features two spacious bedrooms and an adjoining sunroom, complemented by a long hallway, a full bath with shower, tub, and sink (no toilet), and a half bath with a toilet (no sink). The spacious eat-in kitchen, with room for a full dining table, offers the perfect canvas for a sophisticated redesign tailored to your vision.  The lower level includes two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a generous common areaoffering flexible space for guests, family, or work-from-home needs.    Enjoy a large backyard and a good-sized garage, providing both outdoor enjoyment and practical storage.    This is an excellent opportunity in the thriving San Francisco market for buyers ready to update or expand. With its prime location and versatile layout, this home is a rare find for the visionary homeowner. BUYERS TO VERIFY SQUARE FOOTAGE.
